notes.title: Estellium Legends Final Update
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/34287146/b084af7a3f2b06d0b218d4648fd5b2bdacb598fe.jpg

Thank you for purchasing/playing Estellium Legends.

There was an attempted sequel, but sadly that got cancelled. I do appreciate those who did play the game and especially those who bought it.

I wish I could update this game, but the files are unfortunately lost. So I will say one last goodbye before I never touch this game again.

I hope new players and old players will continue to enjoy this game! Thank you!

For everything recent that has been happening,
please check out the Team Syukino store page:

https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/TeamSyukino

notes.title: Estellium Legends Hot Fix v1.0!
notes.content:
I've heard your complaints and seen the issues. Hopefully this hot fix has helped with most of them.

1. Got rid of the Co-Op in the default build and moved it to the test build only. This will hopefully fix the freezing some people have.

2. Fixed a bug that allowed you to jump over the river and get stuck without activating the scarecrow first.

3. Various other small changes and fixes.

Lastly, in order to play co-op with this game, you will need to update your game to the beta version with the password: animadragon56. Please keep in mind that this build is experimental and is prone to some crashing. But if you want to use Parsec or play with a buddy, you will need this build for local co-op.

Thanks and have a nice day!

notes.title: Estellium Legends v1.5 update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34287146/b981270ca64fda3dee5f6755d8a3113e5d1e46a8.png

Here is another free update of Estellium Legends!

-Fixed and changed a few things.

-Removed the previously implemented Row system due to it crashing in
battle.

-Completed Chapter One of the Story Mode.

-Made the game all over easier to navigate for newbies.

That is all for now. Till next time. Story Mode (1/6)

notes.title: Estellium Legends v1.4 update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34287146/b981270ca64fda3dee5f6755d8a3113e5d1e46a8.png

Really not much new in this update to be honest.


-Fixed and changed a couple of things including Aserel's menu picture.

-Added in a Story mode which you can select at the start of a new game. *The Story mode will be worked on over time in the coming updates and is not even close to being finished.

-Added in a new legendary weapon in the shop.

-All updates for the Arena mode have concluded and future updates will focus mainly on the story.

These updates may take some time to come out given recent unfortunate circumstances, but I hope to release a new chapter each update.

notes.title: Estellium Legends v1.3 update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34287146/b981270ca64fda3dee5f6755d8a3113e5d1e46a8.png

Here is another update for Estellium Legends.

Here are a few things:

-Added in the final new character; Mimi (Ataemasu) making the total number of characters 40!
-Added in two more legendary weapons.
-Removed the circle on the main menu.
-Removed some of the fog to improve visibility.
-Added in a small tutorial at the start in Gertalia.
-Added in a secret boss and two explorable areas. *A cave, south of Otestka and A house in Gertalia*
-Added in two new ranks in the new Baby Ranks catergory. *Baby Ranks are only available for people who haven't unlocked Advanced.*
-Added in 3 new items in the Item Shop.
-Added in a Spell Shop for spells to purchase for the player character.

That is all for now, tune in next time for more content. 

Free of course~

notes.title: Estellium Legends v1.2 update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34287146/b981270ca64fda3dee5f6755d8a3113e5d1e46a8.png
Hello and welcome to another update of Estellium Legends.

I want to go over the things that are added in without any hesitation.

Let's go!

-Added in the following characters;

-Sen (Luvocious)
-Epeo (Luvocious) *Second appearence ever.*
-Vivvian (Luvocious) *First time playable in any of my games.*
-Yuki (Luvocious) *Yuki can equip every single weapon in the game, which is why she costs a lot.*
-Aoi (Luvocious)
-Kannono (Luvocious)
-Bulat

-Added in about 8 new areas to explore with more pictures to unlock and secrets to find.

-Fixed Soren's after level up sprite.
-Removed another turn from some Rogue skills.
-Adjusted the weapon shop to seperate range weapons, melee weapons and magic weapons.
-Added in a new class; Brawler and a new skill type: Rage.
-Added in a new type of weapon; Blunt and Glove.
-Added in a Shuriken battle item alongside some new weapons.
-Added in a Legendary Shop that will get more merchandise each update. (Currently sells two legendary weapons).
-Added in a new class, Gunslinger *Epeo Only*
-Added in a Fast Travel for certain locations.

Thanks, that is all folks!

notes.title: Estellium Legends v1.1 update!
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34287146/b981270ca64fda3dee5f6755d8a3113e5d1e46a8.png
Hello guys and welcome to the first update of Estellium Legends. I must warn you, it's a brief one! But, nonetheless let us get started!


-Added in Stun and Paralyze resistance on all bosses.
-Lowered the HP of most bosses.
-Fixed the Angry Shroomface's HP and MP as it's magic was unusable
and it's health was incredibly low.
-Added in achievements.

-Support Donation out now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1028650/Estellium_Legends_Legendary_Donation/

That is all for now, take care!
